title: Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) — Limit and Property Eligibility Conditions
content:
An **Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)** policy is written only within these conditions.

**Conditions of eligibility.** The excess dwelling limit lies between the tier's lowest and highest excess dwelling limit in whole multiples of the tier's limit increment, and the building attachment point plus the excess dwelling limit may not exceed the tier's ceiling percentage of the replacement cost value, which must itself be at least the tier's lowest replacement cost value. Excess personal property may be added only when the tier makes it available, up to the tier's highest excess personal property limit in the same increment.

**Coastal zones.** A property in zone V or VE is written only on a tier that writes V-zone homes and only when an accepted Elevation Certificate shows the lowest floor at least the tier's required number of whole feet above the base flood elevation.

**Certificate zones.** A property in any zone the tier lists as requiring a certificate is bound only with an accepted Elevation Certificate on file, accepted on the same terms as for rating: FEMA Form 086-0-33, sealed by a licensed surveyor, engineer or architect, survey date no more than the tier's maximum certificate age before receipt, and no alteration since.

**Deductible.** The excess policy carries no deductible of its own beyond the tier's excess deductible.

The tier's highest excess dwelling limit, whether it writes V-zone homes and the zones in which it requires a certificate are the tier's own figures.

## Total-insurance test, worked (hypothetical figures)

| Input | Hypothetical value |
|---|---|
| Building attachment point | 250000 |
| Requested excess dwelling limit | 700000 |
| Replacement cost value | 900000 |
| Tier ceiling | 100 percent |

The attachment point plus the limit is 950000, which exceeds 100 percent of 900000; the request fails the test. An excess dwelling limit of 650000 brings the total to 900000, equal to the ceiling, and passes (subject to the tier's limit range and increment).

## Certificate acceptance checklist

| Requirement | Met when |
|---|---|
| Form | FEMA Form 086-0-33 |
| Seal | a licensed surveyor, engineer or architect |
| Age | survey date no more than the tier's maximum certificate age before receipt |
| Alteration | none since the survey |
